base_member_text: [L67-L78,L147-L158] (MED/configuration-contract) The MPI_netcdf configurations contain no PreprocessorDefinitions for USEMPI or USENETCDF, unlike the separate MPI and netcdf configurations, so their names do not match the feature flags they appear intended to enable.
audit_member_text: [L68,L78,L148,L158] (MED/feature-configuration) Combined MPI_netcdf configurations omit feature preprocessor definitions despite compiling against libraries built with both features enabled.

adversarial.rationale: The executable project compiles only input.F90, introspection.F90 and xbeach.F90, none of which contains USEMPI/USENETCDF conditionals or includes requiring those definitions. Its feature-dependent operations are delegated to the static library, whose combined configurations explicitly define both flags (xbeachlibrary.vfproj:68,78,148,158), so omitting unused wrapper definitions does not disable or mismatch those features.

neutralizer.quote:
program xbeach
   use libxbeach_module,     only: executestep, init, final, outputext
   use introspection_module, only: getdoubleparameter
   use iso_c_binding,        only: c_double
   use process_input,        only: readinput
   use xmpi_module,          only: halt_program

base_member_text: [L138] (MED/configuration-path) MPI_Release|x64 searches ..\xbeachlibrary\bin\static\$(ConfigurationName) for the second include directory instead of the x64 path used by the same configuration's first directory.
audit_member_text: [L138] (MED/missing-include-path) MPI_Release|x64 omits x64 from its static-library module include directory.

base_member_text: [L118] (MED/configuration-path) The netcdf_Release|x64 configuration writes object files to bin\win32\$(ConfigurationName) while its output/module paths are bin\x64, mixing architectures/configuration directories.
[L148] (MED/configuration-path) MPI_netcdf_Debug|x64 uses bin\win32\$(ConfigurationName) for both ModulePath and ObjectFile despite being an x64 configuration, causing cross-configuration artifacts.
audit_member_text: [L118,L148] (MED/configuration-contamination) x64 netCDF Release objects and MPI_netcdf Debug objects, modules, and PDB files are directed into Win32 directories.

adversarial.rationale: The netcdf_Release|x64 ObjectFile explicitly selects bin\win32, and MPI_netcdf_Debug|x64 explicitly selects Win32 ModulePath, ObjectFile and PdbFile. The same-named Win32 configurations use those destinations too; correct x64 OutputDirectory/IntermediateDirectory values do not override the explicit compiler paths, and there are no per-file overrides.
